solution.title: Endpoint PowerShell Deployment & Patch Automation Toolkit

products.name: Endpoint PowerShell Deployment & Patch Automation Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: A tested PowerShell automation toolkit for endpoint deployment and patching — parameterized scripts and Intune remediations that run on a schedule, report results, and converge every device to a known-good state. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Replace manual endpoint chores with tested, repeatable PowerShell automation

Endpoint engineers lose hours to the same manual tasks — remediating drifted settings, confirming patch state, deploying or removing software, cleaning up after failed installs — done by hand, differently, every time. This solution gives you a tested PowerShell automation toolkit for endpoint deployment and patching: standardized, parameterized scripts and Intune remediations (proactive remediations) that run on a schedule, report results, and make every device converge to the same known-good state.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the automation model (Intune remediations / proactive remediations + Microsoft Graph + scheduled local scripts), the detect-then-remediate pattern, safe-by-default design, and how results are reported.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, the remediations feature/licensing, Microsoft Graph permissions, PowerShell execution policy/signing, a results destination) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: stand up the toolkit, deploy a detect/remediate pair as an Intune remediation, schedule patch-state checks, wire deployment/cleanup automation, capture results, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — an environment/automation-readiness discovery, a detection/validation script, a fleet automation-results report, a safe remediation script (-WhatIf default), and a deployment/cleanup runner.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The repetitive endpoint work automated — detect-then-remediate jobs running on a schedule, results reported, every device converging to one known-good state — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PSAUTO-Deploy-CleanupRunner.ps1 — software deploy / remove / post-failure cleanup runner. Safe by default
    • PSAUTO-Discovery.ps1 — endpoint automation readiness check
    • PSAUTO-Remediation.ps1 — sample remediation script (paired with PSAUTO-Validation.ps1). Safe by default
    • PSAUTO-Report.ps1 — fleet-wide Intune remediation results (Microsoft Graph)
    • PSAUTO-Validation.ps1 — sample Intune remediation DETECTION script (detect-then-remediate)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
